canberra-1.name: Parliament House
canberra-1.bio: Seat of Australia's federal parliament on Capital Hill, with free daily tours, public galleries and a roof lawn.
canberra-1.ticket_note: aph.gov.au answers scripts with a WAF block page; check in a browser (homepage is the Parliament's own site).
canberra-1.notes: Hours from Wikivoyage: non-sitting days 9-5, sitting days 9-6; free tours 10AM, 1PM, 3PM no booking. Not read on the official site (blocked). Moved 0 m from OSM point.
canberra-1.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=attraction 'Parliament House' (HIGH: Wikipedia and Commons median agree within 100 m); moved 57 m from placement point

canberra-2.name: Australian War Memorial
canberra-2.bio: National war museum and memorial on Anzac Parade, free to enter, with a Last Post Ceremony every day at 4.30 pm.
canberra-2.notes: Official visit page (awm.gov.au/visit): entry free, tickets not required; galleries 10am-5pm daily except Christmas Day, Last Post 4.30pm. Page warns the Memorial is being redeveloped and some galleries may be closed. Visit time from Wikivoyage 'allow 4-7 hours' trimmed to a typical range.
canberra-2.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum 'Australian War Memorial' (HIGH, Wikipedia and Commons agree); moved 21 m from placement point

canberra-3.bio: National art gallery by Lake Burley Griffin, with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander art, Blue Poles and a sculpture garden.

canberra-3.notes: Hours and free entry (special exhibitions extra) from Wikivoyage South Canberra listing; official page blocked. Sculpture garden claim from draft/VisitCanberra, not re-read.

canberra-4.name: National Museum of Australia
canberra-4.bio: National museum on Acton Peninsula covering Australian history, with a First Australians gallery and free entry.

canberra-4.notes: Daily 9-5, free except special exhibitions, from Wikivoyage Acton listing; official page blocked.

canberra-5.name: Old Parliament House
canberra-5.bio: Australia's former Parliament House, now the Museum of Australian Democracy, with its chambers and PM's office open.
canberra-5.notes: moadoph.gov.au/visit: 'Free entry', open 9am-5pm daily (closed Christmas Day); guided tours listed on site (price not read). Site notes building works and some closed exhibitions/rooms. Wikivoyage's $2 entry is outdated. Merged from Museum of Australian Democracy.
canberra-5.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=attraction 'Old Parliament House' (HIGH, Wikipedia and Commons agree); moved 30 m from placement point

canberra-6.name: Questacon
canberra-6.bio: Interactive science and technology centre in Parkes with hands-on galleries, so allow at least two hours.
canberra-6.notes: questacon.edu.au/visiting: open daily 9-5 (closed Christmas Day), pre-booking and timed entry advised, suggests at least 2 hours for exhibitions (4 with cafe, shop). /tickets page: adult $27.50 (first price table; concession $20, family $85); the page does not label the columns so the adult price is the first listed.
canberra-6.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=attraction 'Questacon' (MEDIUM, single OSM feature); moved 13 m from placement point

canberra-7.name: Australian National Botanic Gardens
canberra-7.bio: Native plant gardens at the foot of Black Mountain, with a rainforest gully, a Red Centre garden and water dragons.
canberra-7.notes: visit.anbg.gov.au/visit/opening-hours: open 8.30am-5pm every day except Christmas Day, gates locked outside; parts may close in dangerous weather. Free entry from Wikivoyage Acton listing (parking charged); official fee line not read. Site title: Australian National Botanic Gardens | Parks Australia. Garden features from the site's navigation.
canberra-7.coordinates_source: OSM leisure=garden 'Australian National Botanic Gardens' (HIGH, OSM+Commons agree); moved 190 m from placement point

canberra-8.name: Lake Burley Griffin
canberra-8.bio: Artificial lake at Canberra's centre, with a path around its 40 km shore, cruises, boat hire and swimming beaches.
canberra-8.notes: NCA page (title 'Lake Burley Griffin | National Capital Authority'): shoreline 40.5 km, 3 designated swimming beaches, cruises, kayak/SUP hire. Cruise and hire prices are extras, not the price. Pin: LOW, see coordinates_source. The '25 km shared path' in the draft is not on the NCA page, so dropped.
canberra-8.coordinates_source: Wikipedia article 'Lake Burley Griffin' coordinates (point in the lake's West Basin water; resolve-pin gave only a LOW Commons median 560 m away); a lake is correctly pinned in water; 0 m from placement point

canberra-10.name: Mount Ainslie
canberra-10.bio: Summit lookout reached on foot, by bike or car, with views down Anzac Parade to Parliament House and the lake.
canberra-10.notes: Agency page parks.act.gov.au blocked; ACT reserves and lookouts are free. Wikivoyage: road via North Canberra, 843 m, view along the Anzac Parade axis. Pin on the summit peak node; Wikivoyage's Ainslie Lookout point is about 80 m away.
